text: 创业板指翻红，此前一度跌超3%；科创50指数涨超4%。CPO概念股低开高走，汇绿生态、星网锐捷、沃格光电、科瑞技术、紫光股份等涨停，锐捷网络涨超13%。
text_en: The ChiNext Index turned positive after briefly falling over 3%; the STAR 50 Index rose over 4%. CPO concept stocks opened lower but rallied, with Huilv Ecology, Xingwang Ruijie, Woge Optoelectronics, Kerui Technology, and Unisplendour hitting limit-up, while Ruijie Networks surged over 13%.
